limits.title: Profile photo: the page refuses files over 2 MB before upload
Profile photos: the server refuses images over 2 MB
Business check documents: the panel refuses files over 5 MB before upload
CIPC documents: at most 5 MB per PDF (server intake)
Browser security reports (/api/csp-report): body at most 10 KB
Decryption: refuses encrypted data over 100 MB
Form autosave (/api/drafts): body at most 64 KB
Database call failures: error bodies over 8 KB are not read
Event videos: at most 1 minute (checked by the browser only; the server applies the 2-minute limit)
Per-instance fallback limiter (when the shared limiter is unreachable and the route allows it): 20 requests a minute per key and action, at most 5,000 keys in memory
Post photos: the uploader refuses images over 5 MB before upload
Offload worker: share-card requests at most 8 KB
Offload worker: PDFs at most 5 MB
PDF scan: inflates at most 4 MB per compressed stream
PDF scan: treats more than 16 MB of inflated object streams as unsafe
ID verification uploads: at most 5 MB per file (server validation)
ID verification page: refuses files over 5 MB before upload
Video compressor: copies at most 50 MB of input into memory
Post videos: at most 2 minutes (checked by the browser and again by the server on upload)
Video length check: refuses MP4 index boxes over 32 MB
Post videos: the browser refuses originals over 300 MB before compressing
Post videos: prepared upload at most 50 MB
